integrity.proof: Fully analytical recurrence, Schur criterion, singular mode minimization, and rational three-state certificate
integrity.verification: Exact symbolic reproduction by an included standalone script; finite trajectory checks are supplementary

limitations: The necessary-and-sufficient stability frontier is for fixed-product, two-periodic reciprocal steps of the one-block dual-extrapolated primal-dual method on invertible bilinear saddle couplings.
The sharp matrix-independent contrast cutoff is a qualitative stability guarantee, not a matrix-independent contraction rate.
The strictly convex-concave case supplies one rigorous instability witness, not a complete quadratic parameter classification.
The stated alternating rules violate the source theorem’s quasi-increasing step-sequence hypothesis; safeguarded adaptivity is not asserted to diverge.
Earlier literature already noted qualitative variable-step nonconvergence; exhaustive originality and independent scientific validation are not established.
title: A sharp Floquet frontier for periodically balanced primal–dual steps
